This was at home to Oklahoma City Thunder at Crypto.com Arena. Rui Hachimura dropped 15 points, as Nick Smith Jr. finished with 11 and Drew Timme 11.Golden State Warriors won their last game which was at home. It was a 110-105 triumph at Chase Center against Sacramento Kings. De'Anthony Melton scored 21 points, with Brandin Podziemski adding 20 and Stephen Curry 17.Head-to-Head StatisticsThe Lakers have claimed back-to-back victories over the Warriors.
